hormuz_disruption.label: Iran / Hormuz Disruption
hormuz_disruption.last_note: A reported US-Iran draft deal and JMIC threat downgrade from critical to severe signal a partial reopening pathway — the disruption thesis is structurally real but a ceasefire would rapidly deflate the oil risk premium and collapse the core supply-shock driver.

stagflation_regime.label: Stagflation Regime
stagflation_regime.last_note: BLS confirmed May CPI at 4.2% YoY — the third consecutive monthly acceleration — with energy up 23.5% and shelter up 3.4%, while the FOMC meeting on June 16-17 is locked out of cuts, making stagflation the unambiguous macro regime.

ai_bubble_risk.label: AI Bubble Risk Q4 2026
ai_bubble_risk.last_note: Hyperscaler capex confirmed at $725B for 2026 with capital intensity at 45-57% of revenue — ratios last seen in telecoms — and Amazon FCF projected to turn negative, sustaining bubble risk even as NVDA Q1 revenues of $81.6B validate near-term demand.

gold_supercycle.label: Gold Supercycle
gold_supercycle.last_note: Gold has fallen to approximately $4,159 intraday on reports of a US-Iran draft Hormuz deal, trading well below both the 50-day and 200-day moving averages and exposing the thesis to a ceasefire-driven risk-off unwind; structural central bank buying remains the only intact floor.

copper_deficit.label: Structural Copper Deficit
copper_deficit.last_note: JP Morgan forecasts a refined copper deficit of 330,000 tonnes in 2026 with spot treatment charges at minus $70 per tonne signaling extreme concentrate tightness, and a cumulative structural deficit of 3 million tonnes is projected through 2036.

nuclear_renaissance.label: Nuclear Renaissance
nuclear_renaissance.last_note: AI data center power demand is projected at 156 GW by 2030 requiring $5.2T in cumulative infrastructure investment, and the 45 GW data center gap by 2028 keeps nuclear as the only scalable firm-power solution for hyperscaler load commitments.

ALAB.note: Q1 2026 revenue of $308.4M up 93% YoY confirms the AI connectivity thesis is intact, but the stock has surged over 70% in the past month and now trades at a trailing P/E of approximately 165 — the valuation has materially outrun even the strong fundamental delivery.

POWL.note: The data center electrical equipment thesis remains sound given the confirmed 45 GW power gap by 2028, but at P/E 42.88 the stock is priced for execution certainty that a stagflationary cost environment and supply chain pressure could disrupt.

MOD.note: Negative FCF of minus $101M remains a direct disqualifier for quality-of-earnings discipline — the thermal management thesis is real but negative cash conversion in a rising-rate stagflation regime is an unresolved structural contradiction.

GFS.note: The CHIPS Act foundry thesis has produced no new contract catalysts and GFS is structurally disadvantaged versus TSMC and Samsung in advanced node AI silicon, meaning the original thesis of a domestic fab renaissance has failed to materialize on schedule.

CRDO.note: CRDO grew revenue 157% in its most recent quarter, guides to over $800M in fiscal 2026 revenue implying 120% YoY growth, and the Hyperlume microLED acquisition extends its optical DSP moat — the fundamental thesis is the strongest in the AI connectivity sub-sector.

ARM.note: At P/E 124 with only $750M FCF, ARM remains priced for perfection with no new licensing re-rate catalyst visible — the architecture thesis is intact but the valuation leaves zero margin of safety against any AI capex pause signal in H2 2026.

S.note: SentinelOne at $268M FCF is showing genuine cash generation improvement but the cybersecurity sector remains under consolidation pressure from CrowdStrike and Microsoft, and at P/E 30 the stock has not sufficiently re-rated to reflect its weaker competitive moat.

ZS.note: Zscaler was previously rated AVOID and has the strongest FCF of $1.1B in the cybersecurity cohort with 26% ARR growth, but the P/E of 28 now represents a genuine valuation reset from prior AVOID levels — drift is occurring as the thesis improves toward WATCH.

AXON.note: AXON at EV/EBITDA 379 with only $63M FCF has experienced complete thesis drift — the original law enforcement tech thesis has been overwhelmed by a valuation that requires hyper-growth compounding for a decade without any margin of safety — insider selling reported by TipRanks in early June 2026 is an additional red flag confirming the AVOID signal.

ISRG.note: Intuitive Surgical has zero debt, $4.5B cash, 23% revenue growth, and $2.3B FCF making it a genuine compounder, but at 36x forward earnings and 29.4% below highs the surgical robotics moat thesis is unchanged — the drift is purely valuation-related, not fundamental, and the stock remains a hold-not-add until the multiple contracts further.

RXRX.note: Recursion Pharmaceuticals has revenue growth of minus 56.1%, is burning $178M in FCF with negative operating margins of minus 1985%, and is 55.2% below its 52-week high — the original AI drug discovery thesis has collapsed as clinical pipeline progress has not justified the technology premium and this is now a capital destruction story with no near-term catalyst.

JEDI.note: The drone and modern warfare rearmament thesis is structurally intact given the Hormuz crisis has accelerated defense technology procurement, but at 25% below highs and with no fundamental data available for an ETF wrapper this remains a theme trade that requires a defined technical base before adding risk.

CWAN.note: Clearwater Analytics has 74.4% revenue growth and $160M FCF which is operationally compelling, but analyst targets of $24.47 to $24.55 against the current $24.35 price provide virtually zero upside consensus — at PEG of 10.24 and EV/EBITDA of 73.69 the institutional fintech thesis is fully priced with no margin of safety.

GRAB.note: Grab at $3.30 with $6.5B cash, 23.5% revenue growth, and PEG of 0.87 is the most asymmetric deep value setup in the portfolio on a pure fundamentals basis, but the stock is 50.2% below highs and the Southeast Asia super-app monetization thesis requires a specific catalyst such as a buyback announcement or profitability upgrade to unlock value — thesis intact, no trigger yet.
